messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000143": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000279": As of 2025-03-20, the reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000126": The reporting service is a Dune team service.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000250": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000105" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000097": As of 2025-01-13, the first on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000326" [constraint]: As of 2025-04-15, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000085": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000283" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000338" [decision]: As of 2025-04-21, the Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
Existing entity names: ledger service, reporting service, Dune team, auth gateway, notification service, INC-2025-011, Farah, Boreal team, billing API, Atlas team, notifier, INC-2025-004, the bus, Cinder, webhook dispatcher
